# FG-REPO-0014

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_invalid_project_request_is_project_request_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プロジェクトの情報が正しくありません。入力内容を確認してください。
- en: The project details are not valid. Check what was entered.
- id: Data proyek tidak valid. Periksa kembali isian Anda.

## 原因 (cause)

A request to create or update a project (forge_db::projects::create, step D4; update_decided, `POST /api/v1/projects`, `PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}`, M1 phase 8b MR7a) broke a rule before anything was written: the display name (1 to 255 characters) or the description (at most 2000 characters) is out of range or holds a NUL character, an update names no field (`empty_update`), the parent namespace is a project (projects live only under a personal namespace or a group, ADR-0015 Amendment D4), the parent is a personal namespace whose owner is not active (that owner would inherit Owner of the project), the creator, who becomes the first direct Owner, is not an active user, or the creator is not the acting user of the request (only the operator CLI and the worker, actor `system`, may create a project for another user). A bot as creator, or a bot's personal namespace as parent, is FG-REPO-0010 `bot_member`, as for groups. The path rules are FG-REPO-0007..0009. Also: `forge admin repo reprovision` (step D4 MR3b) was asked to provision a repository that is already `ready` (reason `repository_ready`): there is nothing to provision.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (display_name_length, description_length, nul_character, empty_update, parent_not_owner_namespace, parent_owner_inactive, creator_inactive, creator_not_actor; repository_ready from `forge admin repo reprovision`, with `repo_id`) and `len` where it applies; values are not logged.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the field named by `reason`; create the project below a user or a group, not below another project nor in the namespace of a disabled user; let an active user create it for themselves (creator_not_actor on a route means the route passed something other than its principal: a bug in that route). For repository_ready: do not reprovision; if its directory is missing, that is FG-REPO-0002 (restore from backup, runbook repo-storage).
